lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Philistines came to fight Israel in the valley of Elah.

lines.speaker: jesse
lines.text: Take this grain and bread to your brothers at the camp.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Yes, Father! I'll run the whole way.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I can see the tents!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David heard a giant shouting across the valley.

lines.speaker: goliath
lines.text: Send me a man! Who will fight me?

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Who is he, to defy the armies of the living God?

lines.speaker: eliab
lines.text: Why are you here? Go back to your little sheep!

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: What have I done now? I only asked a question.

lines.speaker: saul
lines.text: You are only a boy. He is a warrior.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I fought a lion and a bear. God saved me then.
lines.caption: The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion… he will deliver me.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I can't walk in this! I'll take it off.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Smooth and round. Just right.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He chose five smooth stones from the brook.

lines.speaker: goliath
lines.text: Am I a dog, that you come with sticks?

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: You come with a sword and a spear.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I come in the name of the LORD of hosts!

lines.speaker: goliath
lines.text: Ha! Ha! A shepherd boy!

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Again! The battle is the LORD's.

lines.speaker: ui
lines.text: Go back to the brook and try again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The stone hit Goliath in the forehead, and he fell on his face.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David won, and the Philistines ran away.

lines.speaker: soldiers
lines.text: David! David!

lines.speaker: ui
lines.text: Chapter 2 complete — The Hero. Next: The Fugitive.
